title: RingCentral data breach exposed info of 1.6 million accounts
summary: The ShinyHunters extortion group stole personal information from 1.6 million RingCentral accounts after hacking the company in July, according to the data breach notification service Have I Been Pwned. Overall prevention scores can hide what happens after initial access.
